title: account_context
description: Versioned copy of account context that pl_copy_context writes to Eventhouse (blueprint step 7). The review-case writer reads it on every delivery and retry. It holds no balance. An account with no row is unknown and goes to quarantine (T02).
x-grain: One row per mortgage_id + cycle_id + context_version.

identity_status.description: conflict when the borrower mapping is in conflict. Anything other than ok goes to quarantine.

payment_support_status.description: active = an unresolved payment-support case. unknown = the servicing feed is stale. unknown holds a renewal review.

context_version.description: Version of this copy, for example ctx-20261015T000000Z.
